original_hook: 🚨 Stablecoin wallets challenge traditional bank accounts as main consumer money hub 📰 CoinDesk reports stablecoin wallets are beginning to challenge traditional bank accounts as primary consumer money hubs. This matters because fiat capital settling natively on-chain creates a permanent liquidity floor. Instead of profits exiting back to TradFi banks, capital remains parked in digital dollars—reducing friction for the next wave of spot $BTC accumulation. With Bitcoin compressing near $79,265, the operational bridge between stablecoin velocity and macro spot demand is tightening. Bullish, bearish, or wait Is this a real repricing event or temporary headline noise?
